question: Can an unlabeled nonlinear-response source criterion acquire a more computationally expressive stimulus/return interface, and does that advance the smaller model relative to the same family of unaligned return interfaces on a larger model?
design: P55 showed that maximizing source state effective rank can select predominantly linear dynamics. This follow-on changes only the source objective and source/assessment streams: learn linear history reconstruction on the first half of the source trajectory, then score remaining response variance along source-whitened state directions on the second half. The score measures response not accounted for by a linear fading-memory model, subject to the same replica echo and state-bound checks. It uses no desired function or evaluation task labels. Evaluate all methods and sizes on a fresh drive after choices freeze. Previous P55 outcomes informed the objective, so this is a new study, not a fresh interpretation of P55.
information_access: Supplied: continuous actuator chart, low-rank return-interface family, polar alignment and curvature-residual learning rules, source stability/diversity objective, finite operating grid and evaluation function family. Acquired: actual neural transport, nonlinear output coordinates, continuous feedback directions/weights and operating choice. Pretrained weights remain fixed; runtime coupling parameters are additional and counted. Native nonlinear temporal activity, not generic self-learning or activation magnitude, is the efficacy target. Larger model is compared within this controlled neural-field apparatus, not claimed inferior at normal language tasks. The new score uses the source drive history as self-supervised linear predictors; the 143 assessment function labels and future test stream remain unavailable at source selection. Residual response is a hypothesis about useful nonlinearity, not capability evidence on its own.
baselines: Per model and seed:18 source candidates for unaligned random return (3 orientations x3 amplitudes x2 radii);18 for first-order aligned return (same orientations/grid);18 for curvature return (3 amplitudes x2 radii x3 nonlinear gains, first orientation). All receive same calibration data and intrinsic source stream. After source selection evaluate unaligned, aligned, curvature, removal of only the selected curvature connection, and same-norm scrambled curvature mode projected orthogonal to the same Jacobian. A source-identified affine-field replay checks that the affine wrapper alone cannot create nonlinear temporal processing. No evaluation-label tuning of operating parameters. Preserve the source effective-rank choice as an additional paired selector for unaligned return; report its separate assessment. All method choices use the same source observations. Extra assessment controls are counted.
resource_accounting: Count all native source/evaluation batches,sequences,tokens,attention andMLP block-tokens; record scalar training/selection CPU, controller arrays and coupling/readout parameters, checkpoint bytes and full process/MLX peaks. Same state8 and observable32 dimensions, source trial counts and assessment train/test streams for all model sizes and primary methods. No inference-time or energy saving assumed. Return-interface coefficients are counted as added runtime parameters. Additional ablation evaluations and verification are recorded separately. P55 audit identified omitted originals in the assessment array estimate. This implementation aliases systems into batch arrays and releases unused Jacobians during native assessment; independent memory audit remains mandatory. The 64MiB value is a nominal explicit-array target, not a whole-process memory cap.
primary_outcomes: Held-out R-squared and summed processing capacity for orthogonal Legendre functionals of the input history, partitioned by totaldegree1..4 and distinct-lag interaction. Main capability outcome is multi-lag nonlinear capacity and number of functions with held-outR2>=.5. Report all per-seed/per-size cases, including unstable/failed operating points, source-selected parameters, first-order map preservation, new-feedback ablation/restoration, deterministic native replay and unchanged weights. Linear-readout labels are used only for assessment after source freezing. Report paired differences against rank-selected unaligned return, all source-selected conditions and the smaller-shaped/larger-unaligned contrast. A favorable isolated seed is not an overall size reversal.
interpretation_rules: First test within-model gains from learned stimulus/coupling; then the predefined smaller-shaped versus larger-unaligned contrast. Describe any cross-size reversal only for this neural computation assay, not overall language intelligence or datacenter obsolescence. Pretraining necessity is not isolated. Source-effective-rank is an intrinsic selection signal and not itself capability evidence. Source curves, assessment capacity and full-resource costs remain separate. If selected nonlinear gain is zero, report no curvature connection rather than claim its effect. Input/output projection and recurrence are supplied architecture; continuous couplings are acquired.
limitations: Two pretrained sizes in one model family; three stimulus/embedding seeds, not independent pretraining replications.
Continuous two-position neural-field execution differs from ordinary text-generation inference.
Feedback state and measured observables are bounded supplied interfaces; whole-model general capability is not evaluated.
Known system identification, feedback control and reservoir-capacity tools are building blocks; the experiment tests their learned neural-stimulus embodiment.
No general claim that more neural activity means greater intelligence.
Source residual may reward nonlinear responses that are not useful or long linear memory beyond the supplied 64-lag reconstruction window.
Prospective follow-on after seeing P55; same model family and assessment family, with fresh stimuli and assessment stream.
stopping_rule: Run all declared models,seeds and primary conditions. Do not select reported cases using assessment capacity. Preserve invalid source points as failures. Stop only for implementation/numerical/memory/weight-integrity failure and prospectively register corrections.
